Found by the #878 session-10 conversion lane for scripts/__tests__/backup-restore-live.test.ts and re-run by the head on unmodified origin/main fa82bdf5.

Receipt (RUNNING, 2026-08-27): OPENBRAIN_BACKUP_DRILL=1 bun run test:isolated scripts/__tests__/backup-restore-live.test.ts -> exit 1, 7 pass 1 fail. The failing test is 'restores into the fresh administrator-bootstrapped non-superuser clone' at backup-restore-live.test.ts:407: runCli('restore.ts', ['--dir', backupDir, '--target-db-url', dbUrl(clone, clone.database)], cliEnv(admin, SRC_DB)) returns exitCode 1, expected 0. The clone database is the one bun run test:isolated supplies as OPENBRAIN_LOCAL_CLONE_TEST_DATABASE_URL (#904). The restore's stderr is not printed by the test, so the cause is not yet known.

Why it was hidden: the suite only runs when OPENBRAIN_BACKUP_DRILL=1 and nothing sets that flag in CI or the pre-push hook, so this failure has never been seen by a gate. #878 removes that gating (rule 36, HANDOVER-RULES); the conversion of this file is blocked on this fix because clause 4 of scripts/done-means/878-pg-tests-require-database.sh requires the ungated suite to pass.

Ask: root-cause with the restore stderr, fix at the owning boundary (scripts/restore.ts or the isolated runner's clone bootstrap, whichever is wrong), RED-first with the existing test as the red.

Parent: #878. Related: #904, #298.

## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-08-28T02:10:24Z

Diagnosis (session-10 read-only lane, head-verified against the receipt on stdout): scripts/restore.ts:596 refuses a non-empty target ('target database is NOT empty (23 user table(s) in schema public)'), and the clone that bun run test:isolated publishes as OPENBRAIN_LOCAL_CLONE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is migrated by scripts/test-isolated.ts:355-368 before the test sees it (scripts/local-clone.test.ts, the #904 consumer, needs that schema). The three sibling restores in the same suite target plain CREATE DATABASE targets and pass. Restore is right; the drill's use of the pre-migrated clone is wrong. Fix: backup-restore-live.test.ts:397-406 creates its own empty database owned by the clone role and restores into it (dropped in afterAll). Landing: folded into the #878 conversion PR for that file, because the pre-commit gate lints the staged file whole (28 findings on origin/main) and a standalone fix would pay the same bill.
